list.title: Projects
list.description: Every repository indexed on this instance. Anyone here can query any of them.
list.emptyDescription: Add a repository and {appName} will clone and index it. That takes a few minutes.

table.indexedCounts: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · {chunks, plural, one {# chunk} other {# chunks}}

reindexDialog.title: Re-index {name}?
reindexDialog.description: The project stays queryable throughout. New vectors are written alongside the current index and swapped in only when the run succeeds.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.description: Its index is destroyed and every conversation against it is removed, for everyone. Re-creating it means a full re-clone and re-embed.
deleteDialog.vectorStoreDown: The vector store is unreachable, so nothing was deleted.
deleteDialog.vectorStoreDownDetail: The project is unchanged. Try again once it is back.

createDialog.title: Add a project
createDialog.description: {appName} clones the repository, indexes it, and deletes the working copy.
createDialog.repoUrlHint: An https URL on an allowed host.
createDialog.patHint: Only for a private repository. Leave blank to keep any stored token unchanged. Scope it read-only — everyone on this instance can query what it indexes.
createDialog.contentLanguageHint: Generated test checklists, mock data, refinement chats and exports are written in this language.

detail.notFound: That project does not exist, or it has been deleted.
detail.reindexRunningDescription: The current index stays queryable until the new one is ready.
detail.membersDescription: Who can reach this project, and as what.
detail.evalDescription: Generated questions with reference answers, run against this project.

addMemberDialog.title: Add a member
addMemberDialog.description: Grant a user access to this project.

memberTable.emptyDescription: Nobody holds a membership on this project yet.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke {name}'s access?
revokeDialog.description: {name} loses access to this project immediately. Their conversations and recorded results stay, and you can add them back later.

contentLanguage.title: Content language
contentLanguage.description: Generated test checklists, mock data, refinement chats and exports are written in this language. Changing it does not rewrite anything that already exists.
